annotations.title: Top gainers and losers on the Moscow Exchange main board (TQBR), with market breadth

description:
Top gainers and losers on the Moscow Exchange main board (TQBR), with market breadth. Ranks TQBR shares by change vs previous close (turnover >= min_value RUB, default 5 mln): top `limit` gainers and losers (default 10, max 50), advancers/decliners/unchanged. Before the session's first trades (mode previous_session) it ranks the last completed session from ISS history. Delayed ~15 minutes.

GET /moex/movers — price $0.004 USDC per call, paid automatically via x402 on Base (only successful responses are charged; 400/404/502 are free).

limit.description: Gainers and losers to return (each side, default 10, max 50) Default: 10.

min_value.description: Minimum turnover in RUB to count a stock (default 5000000; filters illiquid names) Default: 5000000.

name: get_moex_movers
title: Top gainers and losers on the Moscow Exchange main board (TQBR), with market breadth
